signatures.description: In an SSA linear-scan register allocator, given N live intervals (each with start point, end point, and spill weight) and K physical registers, compute an EXACT minimum-total-weight set of intervals to spill so the remaining intervals are K-colorable. The interference graph is an interval graph, so max-weight removal to drop the maximum clique below K is solvable by DP over intervals sorted by end point while tracking the active set at each start point in a bitmask -- the naive greedy 'spill the lowest weight live at each overflow' heuristic is provably suboptimal on instances where a heavy interval overlaps many light ones. Print the spilled interval indices in ascending order followed by the total spilled weight; break ties between equal-weight candidates by choosing the larger index first.
